verdict.rationale: Steel publishes dedicated integration docs for the Claude Agent SDK (in-process MCP tools), the Vercel AI SDK, and CrewAI (a Steel browser exposed as a CrewAI tool). It also documents adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, AgentKit, Browser-Use, and the computer-use loops. Missing for 10: a documented LangChain adapter, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these adapters work.
